notice.all_done: Run all ended: {ran} of {count, plural, one {# flow} other {# flows}} ran, {passed} passed.
notice.all_failed: Run all ended: {ran} of {count, plural, one {# flow} other {# flows}} ran, {passed} passed, {failed} failed ({flows}). Ctrl+Shift+Space F O shows the last results.
notice.hidden: Flow {flow} did not run in {breakpoints}: the layout hides them. The setting Hidden views can show a layout for the run instead.
notice.not_in_grid: Flow {flow} did not run in {breakpoints}: no view of the grid shows them. Add a view of each to run the flow there.

step.pause_hint: The pause before this step as it was recorded (at most 10 s, at least the least pause of the settings). Play waits it at the pace As recorded.

hiddenViews.description: What a flow run does with the views the layout hides: skip them and name them, or show a layout for the run.
hiddenViews.help: Focus mode shows one breakpoint and horizontal mode scrolls views out of sight; the browser holds back hidden pages, so a flow's actions wait in vain there. Skip runs in the views shown and names the others in the result and a notice. Show a layout switches to the layout of Run layout while the run goes on and back after it.
hiddenViews.label: Hidden views

runLayout.description: The layout a flow run shows when Hidden views is set to show a layout: grid, horizontal, split or canvas over the preset shown, or a preset's id.
runLayout.help: A layout mode applies to the preset shown (a focus preset gives way to the main layout); a preset's id shows that preset. A focus preset or an unknown id shows the grid.
runLayout.label: Run layout

followPlayback.description: While a recording plays, the Recorder panel marks the step each view runs, a failed step in red with its reason, and scrolls the running step into sight.
followPlayback.help: The steps are marked either way. Off, the step list stays where it is while a recording plays, so you can read or edit another part of it.
followPlayback.label: Follow the playback

minPauseMs.description: The least pause, in milliseconds, before each step but the first when a recording plays or exports at the pace As recorded. 0 keeps the pauses as recorded.
minPauseMs.help: At the pace As recorded each step waits the pause it was recorded with, at most 10 seconds. A pause shorter than this one waits this long instead, so what a click or a navigation does can be watched. The Recorder panel shows each step's pause beside it.
minPauseMs.label: Least pause between steps

hiddenViews.layout: Show a layout for the run
